Then state plainly what disposition of CTRL-4 the outcomes support, RETIRE or REWRITE, and record what would falsify your own recommendation. If you can construct a MORE DISCRIMINATING mutation for a successor, name it with its expected outcome pre-stated.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the honest reading of this mutation test is narrower than the reading a successor will default to, and in particular whether a FAIL on the two layout mutations will be misread as evidence that CTRL-4 is a working control after all.

STATE THE STRONGEST CASE THAT THE THREE MUTATIONS ARE TOO EASY. A mutation that directly violates the exact identity being checked is close to a tautology in the opposite direction, and a FAIL on it may carry little more information than the PASS it replaces. SAY SO IF YOU BELIEVE IT, WITH THE ARGUMENT.

DO NOT LET A FAIL REHABILITATE CTRL-4. BATCH-015 established that condition (ii) is a constructor identity and that the assertion passes with a non-cube-root zeta3. THAT FINDING IS COMMITTED AND IS NOT REOPENED IN EITHER DIRECTION. CHECK THAT CASE (1) IS NOT RECORDED AS A NEW RESULT and that CASE 0 IS NOT RECORDED AS A RESULT. FLAG EITHER AS BLOCKING.
CHECK THE CLAIM CEILING ITEM BY ITEM AND SAY PLAINLY WHETHER ANY PROHIBITION IS BREACHED. Name the specific sentences a successor is likely to write that WOULD breach it.

RECORD YOUR RECOMMENDED DISPOSITION OF CTRL-4 - RETIRE or REWRITE - WITH ITS REASON, AND RECORD WHAT WOULD FALSIFY YOUR OWN RECOMMENDATION. If you would rewrite it, state the rewritten assertion precisely enough that a successor could freeze it, and PRE-STATE the mutation test it would have to pass.
NAME REQUIRED CONTROLS FOR SUCCESSORS WITH should_it_be_dispatched ANSWERED HONESTLY, INCLUDING AT LEAST ONE YOU WOULD REFUSE, SO YOUR RECOMMENDATIONS ARE FALSIFIABLE.
YOU MAY NOT ENLARGE BATCH-016. Any control you name is FOR A SUCCESSOR and is not dispatched here. Recommend no approval of EXP-STR-004.
SESSION INDEPENDENCE IS REQUIRED AND ASSERTED SEPARATELY. MODEL INDEPENDENCE IS NOT AVAILABLE AND IS NEVER CLAIMED (INT-BATCH016-D).

MINT NO RT-* REPORT IDENTIFIER. INT-BATCH014-N establishes that every RT identifier check in this program has been vacuous and that RT-20260729-036 is a dangling reference that must never be issued. Your report is cited BY PATH AND TASK ID ONLY and must say so in its own text.
MAKE NO COMMIT AND WRITE OUTSIDE YOUR REVIEW DIRECTORY NOTHING AT ALL. TASK-20260730-040 commits your artifacts and nothing else does, and they must not be committed before that ledger commit.
MODIFY NOTHING UNDER harness/. Your diagnostic re-executions are read-only calls into committed code with mutated arguments and mutated returned lists.
